source.title: Hyperledger Fabric SDK for Node.js Class: CryptoSuite
source.applicability: Implementation of cryptographic operations (signing, encryption, hashing) in Hyperledger Fabric blockchain applications, including key management interfaces and algorithms

passages.text: Abstract class for a suite of crypto algorithms used by the SDK to perform digital signing, encryption/decryption and secure hashing. A complete suite includes support for asymmetric keys (such as ECDSA or RSA), symmetric keys (such as AES) and secure hash (such as SHA2/3).
